sanskrit_verse: शब्दाभिधानतत्त्वज्ञौ गणनाकुशलौ शुची / नानालिपिज्ञौ कर्तव्यौ राज्ञा गणकलेखकौ // BrhS_1,1.81
transliteration: śabdābhidhānatattvajñau gaṇanākuśalau śucī / nānālipijñau kartavyau rājñā gaṇakalekhakau
sph_interpretive_translation: The King must appoint a Calculator and a Scribe who are pure, skilled in computation, knowledgeable in semantics and ontological designation, and versed in diverse scripts.
jurisprudential_principles: Causation arises from precise knowledge alignment
Restoration logic requires accurate record and calculation
Consciousness alignment is ensured by purity and semantic clarity
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler requires administrative function THEN appoint only those with demonstrated computational accuracy
IF record-keeper lacks scriptural literacy THEN disqualify from official duty
IF individual exhibits impurity THEN exclude from data-handling roles
IF semantic confusion detected THEN reassign personnel immediately
IF textual multiplicity encountered THEN ensure interpreter proficiency across all relevant lipis
supreme_court_application: At the highest judicial level, this axiom ensures that court-appointed clerks and accountants possess both linguistic versatility and numerical precision, preventing systemic errors rooted in miscommunication or miscalculation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that incorrect accounting leads to disorder; anupūrvaśaḥ shows how error cascades without proper oversight; proportional responsibility assigns corrective action to the source of distortion; the non-punitive reality rule restores integrity without blame.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Re-training in śabda-vyavahāra for deficient scribes
Meditative purification for lapses in śaucam
Cross-script certification process for expanded lipe-jñānam
Automated audit reconciliation for gaṇanā-kuśalatā verification
Public affirmation of corrected appointment upon successful realignment
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, the Law stands established: only those aligned in consciousness, purified in conduct, and perfected in skill shall serve in governance. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
